summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to gradually reduce the manufacturer discount percentage for plasma-derived products under Medicare Part D, starting in 2026 and reaching 80-90% by 2030-2032, depending on whether the beneficiary has met their out-of-pocket threshold.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act to provide a phase-in for plasma-derived products under the manufacturer discount program for Medicare Part D. This directly impacts the cost and accessibility of certain medicines within a public healthcare program, thus affecting healthcare policy.
